activity.notes: Second royal voyage, 1535–1536. Cartier entered and explored the St. Lawrence River, reached Stadacona and Hochelaga, and wintered near present-day Quebec City. It is stored separately from the 1534 and 1541–1542 voyages because the expeditions were distinct episodes with intervening gaps.

sources.title: Jacques Cartier (1491–1557) — Dictionary of Canadian Biography
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography records Cartier's second expedition beginning in May 1535, his exploration of the St. Lawrence River and the expedition's return in 1536.

sources.title: Cartier's voyages — Parks Canada
sources.citation_text: Parks Canada identifies the second voyage as 1535–1536 and describes it as the expedition that established the St. Lawrence River as a route into the continent.
